bathsMin.description: Only include properties with at least this many bathrooms (decimals allowed, e.g. 1.5). Leave blank for no minimum.
bathsMin.title: Minimum bathrooms

bedsMax.description: Only include properties with at most this many bedrooms. Leave blank for no maximum.
bedsMax.title: Maximum bedrooms

bedsMin.description: Only include properties with at least this many bedrooms. Leave blank for no minimum.
bedsMin.title: Minimum bedrooms

dateFilter.description: Show only showings in this window. Choose Custom range to use the date fields below. Zillow has no verified server-side date filter, so this is applied to the exact showing dates after collection.
dateFilter.title: Open-house date

dateFrom.description: Include only showings on or after this date. Used when the date filter is Custom range (or when no preset is selected).
dateFrom.title: Custom range: from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Include only showings on or before this date. Used when the date filter is Custom range (or when no preset is selected).
dateTo.title: Custom range: to (YYYY-MM-DD)

homeTypes.description: Limit results to specific property types. Leave empty for all types.
homeTypes.title: Home types

includeAgentContact.description: Include the listing agent and broker phone numbers and any published agent email found on the detail page. Off by default.
includeAgentContact.title: Include agent contact details

includeDetails.description: Open each listing's detail page for agent/broker, photos, description, year built, lot, HOA, and MLS. Adds one request per listing; rows still return with search-page fields when a detail page fails.
includeDetails.title: Include full property details

locations.description: US locations to search, one per line: a city ("Austin, TX"), ZIP code ("78704"), or neighborhood ("Hyde Park, Austin, TX"). Boroughs ("Brooklyn, NY") and counties ("Travis County, TX") also resolve. Each location is resolved through Zillow's autocomplete.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of open-house showing rows to return across all locations and URLs (1-500). Each row is one showing.
maxItems.title: Max showings

maxPrice.description: Upper bound on the listing price. Leave blank for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price ($)

minPrice.description: Lower bound on the listing price. Leave blank for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum price ($)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy overrides. Leave empty and the actor picks the working route automatically: direct first, then Apify Proxy AUTO, then a paid unblocker/residential group only after Zillow returns a real 403/PerimeterX block.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (optional)

startUrls.description: Zillow search or open-house URLs to scrape instead of, or in addition to, locations. Legacy open-house paths are converted to the filtered 1_open path and the open-house filter is applied automatically.
startUrls.title: Zillow search URLs

timeZone.description: US time zone used to interpret today/this weekend and to floor open-house dates.
timeZone.title: Time zone
